Rest of box not legible. Midnight Oil debut and Species Deceases are common titles (Discogs medians roughly US$14-18).

viewing_check: Photograph the spines and covers through the whole box (not just the front five) and name every title. Identify the artist and title on the X 14334 promo 12-inch (cover and label). Check vinyl condition on the Midnight Oil debut and EP (scratches, warps, original Powderworks pressing). Look for any rare Australian titles, Skyhooks first pressings, or picture discs deeper in the box. Photos alone do not settle it: the box is mostly common titles, so the Gowans comps range is about $60 to $330 hammer, with a typical named-act box near $130.
